title: Rewrite identity chapters per D1-D3
description: Ch 2-8 (01-overview, 03-identity), README, PRFAQ. Handle->DID->IPNS chain; did:webvh default; WebFinger for alice@domain; custody per D2 (operator-held IPNS key default, self-custody option); hostile-migration cutoff rule (reject old-IPNS-key signatures after DID log rotation); remove 'DID audit trail' claims for did:web; did:plc is a single registry, not distributed; IPNS name embeds Ed25519 key (identity multihash), not a hash; fix Earl/IPNS-unchanged contradiction; did:key cannot carry service entries (define pointer or disallow); persona unlinkability claim is false in one public DID doc; HNS listed but not defined; IPNS handle method is self-claim; ENS text records live in resolver; drop ipns= from TXT; MVP 'raw IPNS only' contradicts DID-primary MUST.
notes: From esol.4: Ch 34 needs (a) CorundumIdentity service (Ch 6) to list ALL content-signing keys (Ed25519 IPNS name + future PQ keys) = the 'required set'; (b) attributedTo (Ch 11) to name the author's DID, since authorization resolves DID -> keys; (c) RootManifest identity block to carry the DID.
close_reason: Ch 5-8 rewritten: handles->DID(did:webvh default, plc/key opt-in, no plain did:web)->IPNS; operator-held content key default, self-custody option, user-held update/recovery keys; WebFinger + DNS handles; migration by DID update; MigrationNotification is a hint; portable:true required. Ch 1-3, 04 examples (attributedTo = DID), README, PRFAQ updated.
